notablePrerequisites: You have at least one card in hand.
description:
Activate Chivalric Alliance by paying {2} and discarding a card, creating a 2/2 Knight creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Knight, adding {C}{C}.
When the Knight dies, Moldervine Reclamation triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and draw a card.
Repeat.
